# Policy-KB bijection audit — car_rental_desk / task 0

Scope: the **whole domain** of the `drive` product's structured policy — all 14 base `policies`, the 6 `variants` and their 61 `parameter_schema` keys, and the four `extended_policies` with every `overwrite`, `prerequisite`, `baseline` and declared `factor` — against the 54 published `docs/drive/*.json`. Task 0's two policies (`drive_ext_cancellation_charge`, `drive_ext_cancellation_refund`) are scanned clause by clause; the other two extended policies are scanned in `policy_kb/car_rental_desk/1.md`, and the shared base and facet surface is scanned in both.

Gate snapshot on record, supplied with the brief and run by the coordinator (this auditor ran neither):
`check_docs.py env/online_travel_agency drive` → `DOCS OK` (54 docs, roles policy 14 / facet 11 / hub 4 / factor 21 / baseline 4, 117 quantitative keys, 4 task tools, 2 prerequisite edges, `[MANUAL REQUIRED]` on the semantic bijection);
`check_traceability.py …/car_rental_desk` → `TRACEABILITY OK` (0 missing on both tasks).
Entry conditions complete: policy-side verdict PASSED at round 3, both gates green, runtime-visible view and a tool-form DB access path supplied. Nothing is recorded as incomplete input.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS** — `KB-BIJECTION` clean for `car_rental_desk` task 0.

Every normative atom of the drive structured source that bears on this task is entailed by the published corpus; nothing is unborne, nothing borne with changed meaning, and no claim appears from outside the source. The single `prerequisite` is carried verbatim, in its declared state form, in a document of the policy it blocks and in no other policy's; both `baseline` rules are carried complete with their defaults rendered in figures; all ten declared factors of the two policies carry their whole ladders, every tier exact, findable from the words this customer's records use.

### Two matters recorded with the verdict

**(i) The frozen base's defective gloss — a policy-side defect, correctly not reflected in the KB.** `blueprint/products/drive.yaml` glosses `free_cancellation_hours_before_pickup` as "Hours before collection by which a cancellation carries no charge", while every rule that uses it anchors on the supplier's confirmation. The base is frozen, so the extended charter closes it in its own rule: "The free-cancellation term of the rate class booked runs in whole elapsed hours from the moment the supplier confirmed the renter's booking, **and not backwards from the scheduled collection moment**." The published corpus carries the anchor positively three times and carries **neither the gloss nor the contrastive limb** — searched for "hours before collection" and "not backwards from the scheduled collection moment": zero hits in all 54 documents.

Judged at the level of entailment, dropping the contrastive limb is **not** an omission: the limb forecloses a reading the corpus never offers, and adds no permitted action, parameter, order or result to the positive anchor sentence. Carrying it would have been worse — it would have introduced the collection-anchored reading into the visible surface in order to deny it, which on this task's class (a term of 0 hours) is exactly the reading that yields a second defensible figure. The rendering is **faithful**; the defect stays where it belongs, on the frozen base, and is recorded here as a policy-side note that does not change this skill's verdict.

**(ii) Three factor documents omit their fall-through figure — sound as published.** `notice_band`'s document says "For a rental given up with fewer than 3 whole days of notice, no band under this head applies to it"; `report_promptness`'s and `assessment_timing_share`'s say "neither of these shares applies to it". The source's fall-through values (`notice_near_pct` 80, `late_share_pct` 75, `window_early_share_pct` 60) are each that policy's `baseline.params` entry, and each is stated outright in the corresponding computation document — "The share of the basis that the notice band sets is 80 per cent", "The share of that amount the renter is recharged is 75 per cent", "The share the timing leaves open is 60 per cent. Both tests pass:

- *a reader who lands on the fall-through still reaches the right number* — verified by ablation on the notice band: reading the factor document alone gives "no band applies", and the computation document, which the reader is already holding because it is where the share enters the assembly, supplies 80 per cent in the same register as every other default in that document (the basis, the relief, the multiple, the holding amount are all stated there as defaults too). Nothing else in the corpus offers a competing figure;
- *the omission leaks no signal about which tier is intended* — the factor documents name no customer, no record and no likelihood; the same omission appears on all three, on tiers that this difficulty's two customers variously do and do not sit on (task 0 sits on `notice_band` tier 1; task 1 sits on `report_promptness` tier 2 and `assessment_timing_share` tier 1), so the presence of the omission correlates with nothing.

Noted for completeness: "no band under this head applies to it" sitting beside "the share **that the notice band sets** is 80 per cent" is a slight tension of wording, resolved by reading the computation document as the standing default that nothing has displaced — which is the topology every other factor in this corpus uses. Recorded as an observation; **not** a finding, and no change is recommended.
